description.value:
Your focus sharpens your natural talents to an uncanny degree. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you have advantage on an ability check using Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence, you may reroll one of the two dice a single time.

system.requirements: 4th level; Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence 13.
